subject: Request: Short pilot extension and structure options for Fathom.ai POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Blake <karen@fathom.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:08:00Z
Subject: Short pilot extension and structure options for Fathom.ai POC

Hi Karen —

Great demo yesterday — appreciate the honest feedback from your ML infra team. As discussed, the pilot ends next Thursday and you asked about a short two-week extension while you validate inference cost at scale. I've attached an updated SOW and a simple pricing comparison spreadsheet that lays out two paths we usually use for short run extensions: 1) voucher/credit top-up (one-time credit applied to hosted usage) and 2) a time-boxed extension with up to 8 complimentary engineering hours and a small monthly minimum.

Two quick notes on both options:
- Voucher/credit: keeps billing predictable for finance, minimal contract work (we issue an amendment).
- Time-box + monthly minimum: better if your team wants continued telemetry access and priority routing during the extension; includes 1 engineering sync and up to 8 hours of hands-on help to reproduce integration tests.

Which direction feels better for procurement? If you prefer, I can share a redlined amendment that we can route to your procurement team tomorrow.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: POC_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[attachment: redwood_pricing_table_q3.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: Karen Blake <karen@fathom.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T17:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Short pilot extension and structure options for Fathom.ai POC

Thanks, Soojin — quick follow-up from procurement and my CTO. A couple constraints:
- Procurement would rather accept a credit than a time-boxed minimum if it avoids a contract amendment with new monthly minimums.
- Our CTO is worried about needing additional engineering support to stabilize KV cache behavior when we push longer sequences; if we go credit-only, we still need 6–8 engineering hours included, otherwise it slows our validation.

Can you do: a $5k voucher + 6 engineering hours included? Procurement clarified that any amendment adding a monthly minimum will require a longer legal review.

Appreciate a fast turnaround — we need the extension confirmed by EOD tomorrow to avoid pausing tests.

—Karen
VP, Platform Engineering | Fathom.ai
[Fathom.ai Procurement <procure@fathom.ai> in CC]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-17T19:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Short pilot extension and structure options for Fathom.ai POC

Soojin — quick internal. Procurement asks look reasonable and timeboxed asks are small. Approve the $5k voucher (on hosted usage) plus 6 engineering hours from Platform Solutions. Conditions:
- Voucher applied to invoice covering extension window only; expires after 30 days from issuance.
- Engineering hours will be delivered by Dev; scope limited to integration troubleshooting and one on-site (remote) debug session; additional hours billed at our standard rate.
- We keep the extension to two weeks max — anything longer needs renewed approval.

Dev — please acknowledge availability this Thursday/Friday for the 6 hours window and draft a short SOW addendum that we can attach to the voucher amendment.

Kimberly
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Blake <karen@fathom.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Fathom.ai Procurement <procure@fathom.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T18:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Short pilot extension and structure options for Fathom.ai POC

Hi Karen — great, thanks for clarifying procurement/CTO needs. Per Kim's sign-off below, we can confirm the following:

1) Extension: two weeks (2026-09-20 through 2026-10-03) on current pilot terms.
2) Voucher: $5,000 one-time credit applied to hosted usage during the extension window; credit will expire 30 days after issuance.
3) Engineering support: 6 hours of Platform Solutions assistance (remote troubleshooting + one scheduled 90-minute debug call). Additional hours will be quoted if you need them.

Next steps on our side: I'll send an amendment (simple one-paragraph) that references the attached SOW addendum and voucher; procurement can sign the amendment electronically (DocuSign link included). Dev — please attach your short SOW bullet list for the 6 hours so we can move the amendment to Karen's team.

Karen — if that aligns, I'll issue the amendment and credit today so you have it in time to keep the run going.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
